columns.name: POLREF
columns.description: Unique reference of the policy on the policy file.

columns.name: PRDREF
columns.description: Code of the product the policy was sold under.

columns.name: PRDVRS_NO
columns.description: Version of the product terms the policy was issued on.

columns.name: POLCRCDTE
columns.description: Date the policy came into force, in YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: STRDTE
columns.description: Date from which the details on this policy record apply. For endorsements this may be later than the currency date. YYYYMMDD format.

columns.name: EXTMOD
columns.description: Reason the case has exited. 0 means the policy has not exited. Values are held in GSDs and CS060.

columns.name: PUPDTE
columns.description: Date from which paid-up details apply, in YYYYMMDD format. 00000000 means the policy has never been made paid up.

columns.name: ORIMATDTE
columns.description: Maturity date agreed at inception, required for projections, in YYYYMMDD format. Initially the same as POLMATDTE; differs where the maturity has since been moved. 00000000 for products with no maturity.

columns.name: POLMATDTE
columns.description: Current maturity date of the policy, in YYYYMMDD format. 00000000 for products with no maturity (annuities).

columns.name: STAPOL
columns.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy record. Values are held on GSDs and CS060.

columns.name: QLYPOL
columns.description: Whether the policy qualifies for tax relief on the benefit. Obtained from the corresponding PR010 record.

columns.name: PRMBAS
columns.description: Regulatory basis the premium was calculated on.

columns.name: CNDBK_CDE
columns.description: Identifies the policy conditions booklet issued with the policy.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CHARGE_BASIS
columns.description: Charge basis for an RS policy. Control field with a constant value of 0 in this extract.

columns.name: SRVBRN
columns.description: Alpha code of the branch that services the policy, validated against the location dataset CL570.

rules: Each policy is uniquely identified by POLREF.
All dates on this file are YYYYMMDD text; 00000000 means no date.
PUPDTE is 00000000 unless STAPOL is 25 (Paid Up).
EXTMOD is 0 while the policy is in force or paid up; otherwise it gives the exit route that matches STAPOL.
ORIMATDTE equals POLMATDTE unless the maturity date has been moved since inception.
POLMATDTE and ORIMATDTE are 00000000 for Immediate Annuity (IR-05) policies.
